dashboard.title: Your infrastructure, at a glance.

auth.usernameHint: Use 3–80 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Leave blank to generate a secure random username.

auth.generatePassword: Leave blank to generate a strong random password
auth.generatedHint: These generated credentials are shown once. Save them before dismissing this panel. Your account username is separate from your display name.
agent.dockerRequirements: Requires Linux rootful Docker and root access. The command enrolls the Agent and starts its container; updates are built in.
operations.description: Available operations and forms are supplied by the connected Core.
updates.title: Update center
updates.description: Verified releases, saved deployment settings, durable progress and automatic failure rollback.
updates.install: Updates are built in. Run the standard managed deployment with the required host permissions.
updates.currentNotice: No newer stable release is available.
updates.rollbackWarning: Rollback returns to the previous runtime. Core data returns to its pre-update backup. Agent credentials and task state stay current.
updates.updateWarning: The service will restart. Data and credentials are preserved, with a private backup and automatic rollback if verification fails.
dialog.title: Confirm action
host.title: Host management
host.subtitle: Sampling, asset monitoring and operations across your nodes.
host.selectionHint: Each node has a separate result; offline nodes report an error.
host.settingsHint: Sampling settings apply on the next sample. Network settings apply on the next connection. Arrays contain one entry per line.
host.assetsHint: Expiry and traffic reminders use the asset_expiry and traffic_quota rules in the alert center. Expiry uses an RFC3339 date; leave it empty to disable.
host.commandHint: Scripts run as root. Confirm execution before submitting. A failed submission can be retried with the same request key.
host.probeHint: Create the same target on each selected node. ICMP targets use icmp://hostname; TCP targets use tcp://hostname:port.
host.enrollmentHint: One temporary key can enroll a bounded number of Agents. Every Agent receives its own credential and identity. Revoke the key to stop further enrollment.
host.secretHint: Copy this key now; it is shown only once. Use it at the installer credential prompt. Installation requires root.
host.partialTraffic: Partial coverage: unobserved traffic is not included.
host.field.name: Name
terminal.unavailable: The shell could not be resumed. Open a new terminal.
terminal.reconnectingHint: Input pauses during reconnecting; it is never replayed.
api.terminalGone: terminal session is no longer available
terminal.endedHint: The session has ended. Open a new terminal to continue.
operations.retryIntent: Retry keeps the same intent key. Copy it before leaving this page. Start a new execution only when you intend to run the operation again.
operations.rawJSON: Use JSON request body (including explicit null values)
operations.restoreHint: Re-enter the same body or file. Restoring the key does not submit work; changed content will be rejected by Core.
guest.settingsHint: Select exactly what visitors may see. Everything is private until selected and published.
guest.readOnly: Read-only display of explicitly published data.
guest.enabled: Enable guest mode on the login page
guest.title: Display title
guest.namesHint: Public names are separate from internal names. New resources are never automatically published.
guest.unavailable: Guest mode is no longer available.
